record.rationale: Task6764KT in-progress font/style dropdown pipeline: original FontNameBox item sizing, five-pixel fit loop, own-name eligibility, exact script/minimal/symbol sample order, right-aligned sample truncation and scoped paint state are represented. Browser Canvas consumes acquired face metadata and real TextMetrics; no glyph support is inferred from CSS fallback. Writer paragraph FillPreview flattens real root/parent/child item sets and temporarily resolves unused pool styles before deleting new collections in reverse creation order; no persistent style store, model revision, modified or history mutation is introduced. The old unused GetDocumentStylePoolManager accessor is canonicalized to native getIDocumentStylePoolAccess. WRITER072 documents the preserved minimal-sample overwrite. Browser font-source acquisition, real popup/style rendering and Writer/Calc acceptance remain unfinished. Focused deterministic device tests are not installed-font or Chromium-raster evidence; no broad parity/default status is promoted.
